look_first: Look behind the corolla for five persistent sepals, then read the five folds of the fused corolla; confirm superior ovary and capsule when fruiting.

confusable.tie_breaker: Morning-glories have ordinary stamens, persistent sepals and capsule fruit; local milkvines have specialized central reproductive structures and follicles.
Passiflora climbs with axillary tendrils and has a corona plus elevated reproductive column; morning-glories usually twine by the stem.

exceptions: Cuscuta is a parasitic threadlike, nearly leafless family exception.
Heart-shaped leaves are not a family requirement.
